cards.text: Jesus is leaving the temple and walking away when His disciples come up to Him to point out its buildings. Friend, that's me pulling a tray out of the oven and making everybody look at EVERY single cookie on it, one at a time.

cards.question: The disciples are pointing out the temple buildings. What does Jesus tell them about those buildings?

answers.text: Not one stone will be left on another
Every stone will be covered in gold
Every stone will stand for all time

cards.question: Later, Jesus is sitting on the Mount of Olives, and the disciples come to Him privately. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: When it will happen and what the sign will be
Who will tear the temple down and how
Where they should go and who to bring

cards.text: They're asking for the sign of His coming and of the end of the age, and they want a date circled on the calendar with a reminder on the phone. But Jesus starts His answer with a warning.

cards.question: What's the first warning Jesus gives the disciples?

answers.text: Don't go back to the temple

cards.question: Jesus warns that many will come in His name claiming to be the Christ, but they will deceive only a few. True or false?

cards.text: Next, Jesus says the disciples will hear of wars and rumors of wars. RUMORS, friend, like a group chat that buzzes all night long and nobody even knows who started it.

cards.question: When the disciples hear of wars and rumors of wars, how does Jesus tell them to react?

answers.text: Get out of the city fast

cards.question: Jesus says the wars must happen, but the ___ is still to come.

cards.text: And it keeps coming: nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, with famines and earthquakes in various places. Friend, I hear that list and my eyebrows go up so high they knock my chef's hat clean off.

cards.question: Jesus sums up the wars, famines and earthquakes with one picture. What does He say they are the beginning of?

cards.text: The BEGINNING, friend, not the finish line. Then Jesus tells the disciples they'll be handed over to be persecuted and killed.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples they will be hated by all nations because of His name. True or false?

cards.text: At that time many will fall away and betray and hate one another, and many false prophets will arise and "deceive many." That's the second time Jesus says deceive many, friend, and when He says something twice, I write it on my apron in BIG letters.

cards.question: Because wickedness multiplies, Jesus says the love of most will grow ___.

cards.text: Okay, that's a heavy list, friend. But then Jesus talks about the one who perseveres to the end.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who perseveres to the end will be ___.
Jesus says this gospel of the kingdom will be preached only in Israel, and then the end will come. True or false?

cards.text: In all the world, as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come. Pull up a seat, friend, because Jesus is still sitting on that mountain and He is NOT done talking.
